question: Which remaining Linux companion app direction should OpenClaw sponsor for this umbrella now that Windows Hub is documented and released?
rationale: The remaining work is broad platform product and security-sensitive packaging work with multiple active implementation candidates, so automation cannot safely choose the app architecture or ownership boundary.

options.title: Pick a Linux app track and keep the umbrella
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers choose the GTK/C, Rust/GTK, or another Linux app path and review that path through security, packaging, and release proof.

options.title: Split remaining work into narrower issues
options.body: Close or de-scope the broad umbrella only after creating canonical Linux packaging, native capabilities, notifications, and docs/release follow-ups tied to a chosen architecture.

options.title: Treat Windows as done and close Linux separately
options.body: Close this umbrella only if maintainers explicitly decide the Linux companion app should move to a separate owner item or outside core.

recommendation.title: Pick a Linux app track and keep the umbrella
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers choose the GTK/C, Rust/GTK, or another Linux app path and review that path through security, packaging, and release proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete opened the issue, gave product-direction comments in the thread, and owns the current platform-status wording in source history.
